webhookQa.transport: Actual public HTTPS through an ephemeral controlled Cloudflare tunnel; only the synthetic HMAC receiver is exposed, not the application
webhookQa.signature: timestamp plus actual raw body; constant-time HMAC verification
webhookQa.retry: first delivery 503, next 204; same delivery ID and raw payload; replay causes no second processing
webhookQa.cancellation: pending deliveries cancelled before network send after project membership revocation
webhookQa.dns: Host system resolver did not resolve temporary tunnel names. In the scratch QA copy only, addresses() receives actual A/AAAA answers from Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS for the exact controlled host. Original URL validation, all-address public IP checks and CURLOPT_RESOLVE pinning remain active. A loopback negative probe is rejected.
webhookQa.tls: Host default CA path produced cURL 77. Scratch-only middleware selects the existing trusted /etc/ssl/cert.pem CA bundle. Certificate and hostname verification remain enabled; no verify=false or CURLOPT_CONNECT_TO.
webhookQa.freshMfa: The long visual matrix can outlast fresh proof. The QA harness uses a new valid synthetic recovery code before project access revocation; real MFA rules are unchanged.
